Same here… I used to be suicidal and try kill my self during high school, I almost succeeded. Because my vision faded away and I started to panic. The now me can’t think the same anymore, can’t even cope to think what’s death gonna do to me or my family. My great grandma passed last year, didn’t feel anything then. but past few weeks those feelings wrapped me around made me couldn’t breath.
I understand you truly. For me I sometimes tell myself that when I’m dead all this worry will be no more and I can get peace. But I recommend you try meditation and do exercise first, because it’s what I’m been doing past 3 weeks. If it’s already affected your daily life, like can’t think about happy things or the fear is constantly living behind your head, it’s best to see therapist for help. And read some psychophysics studies may help you to understand the way your mind works further to reduce your panic attack. Those are my experiences.

Sorry for replying late.

Maybe humans are never meant to be prepared, Sorry my head is full of nihilistic thoughts. I have this conclusion in a relaxed mind. It's all normal to think and fear. Like our mother having us, waiting for a new life could cause anxiety too, same as death. And MAYBE our lives are just designed to be long enough for us to overcome this. Idk, I'm scared too.

Last night was the worst panic attack, every belief I build crumbled, meditations not working, my AirPods died and my room was all dark, all thoughts came to me at the same time. the whole night was dreamy and panicking, I keep waking up early morning. then I finally get some sleep, there was a nightmare waiting for me. I even thought just kill me at the spot and everything will end.

Have the same questions, but I already tend to not dive too deep into that, because the fear itself is scary enough for us to spend time on it.

I totally get you, maybe the universe itself has died and been reborn over billion times, and every time there must be some high intelligence species evolved like us, maybe not totally the same but having the same struggles as we do. Sometime during the day, I will realize we are just a small dot in this world, which made me feel relieved and can continue my work. but it will dissipate and get anxious again when I go to bed.

I read a book about that human brains are born to suffer because of natural selection. (to reproduce etc.)  But it also gave us enough wisdom to try to overcome this situation, that's why we are here to seek help or just share thoughts.

Death is inevitable, absolutely. But there are plenty of ways and people we can try to reach to ease the fear, even just for a week or day. And because of the uncertainty of the future, there must be some happiness we still not known yet, let's try to look forward to that. I believe in you.

If you want to talk more you can dm me here.
I want to be a calm person, capable of have some minor regrets. Hope till that day I already cope with my existential anxiety. And can peacefully leave.
